instruction: Use the Autodesk Fusion 360 GUI in the Manufacture workspace. Open the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\outer_plate.step. Create a 2D Contour operation for the outside boundary of the plate. Set the WCS origin at the top-face center, machine the outside boundary down to Z=0.000 mm, leave 0.2 mm radial stock, and include one finish pass. Tool definition: T1 is a 6 mm flat end mill for 2D contouring, S9000 rpm, F650 mm/min. In the NC Program or post-process dialog, use metric units and the selected post processor for this setup, then export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-2.nc to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths.
